skill.description: Create and apply brand systems across voice, visual identity, messaging, assets, color, typography, and compliance workflows.
skill.summary: Build consistent brand guidelines, content voice, visual standards, and asset workflows for marketing and product teams.
skill.author: nextlevelbuilder

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown code fences, JavaScript template literals, regular-expression exec calls, and expected local filesystem checks. A real issue remains in scripts/sync-brand-to-tokens.cjs, which imports child_process and runs execSync with a shell command string. The prompt-context helper also needs guardrails before placing local brand text into model prompts.

remediation.issue: Shell command execution in token sync script
remediation.suggestion: Replace the execSync command string with an argument-array API such as execFileSync or spawnSync. Validate paths before execution.

remediation.issue: Prompt context from local brand guidelines lacks injection guardrails
remediation.suggestion: Treat guideline files as untrusted input. Strip instruction-like directives or place extracted content in a lower-priority data section.

remediation.issue: Generated command examples include raw file paths
remediation.suggestion: Avoid printing copy-paste shell strings with unsanitized paths. Prefer clear arguments or a warning for untrusted file names.

semantic_findings.title: Prompt Context Built From Local Markdown Without Injection Guardrails
semantic_findings.description: The context generator reads local brand guidelines and places extracted values into a prompt addition without neutralizing instruction-like text. This is an AI prompt-injection surface if the guideline file contains hostile instructions.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code directly builds BRAND CONTEXT prompt text from values extracted from a local file and prints it for model use. I found no malicious bundled instructions, so this is a guardrail gap rather than an active attack.

content.user_title: Build Brand Guidelines and Asset Workflows
content.value_statement: Brand work often drifts across voice, visuals, assets, and design tokens. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code create, review, and apply consistent brand systems.
actual_capabilities: Create brand guideline structures for color, typography, logo usage, imagery, voice, and messaging.
Review content and assets against documented brand voice and visual rules.
Validate asset names, file types, file sizes, and manifest registration with included Node scripts.
Extract color palettes from brand guideline markdown and compare colors with image analysis workflows.
Sync documented brand colors into design token JSON and CSS when the companion token generator exists.
Generate brand context summaries for prompts from a local brand guideline file.
limitations: It does not verify legal trademark ownership or licensing.
Image color extraction requires ImageMagick or another multimodal tool outside this skill.
Script outputs depend on local files such as docs/brand-guidelines.md and assets/design-tokens.json.
Brand decisions still require human approval for strategy, accessibility, and market fit.

use_cases.title: Create a New Brand System
use_cases.description: Define voice, color, typography, logo rules, and messaging for a new product launch.

use_cases.title: Review Campaign Assets
use_cases.description: Check campaign copy, visuals, and file names against established brand rules before publication.

use_cases.title: Sync Brand Colors to Tokens
use_cases.description: Translate approved brand colors into token files used by product interfaces.

prompt_templates.title: Create Starter Guidelines
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a first brand guide.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a starter brand guide for [product]. Include voice traits, color roles, typography, logo rules, imagery, and asset naming.

prompt_templates.title: Review Brand Consistency
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of copy or visual direction.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this content for brand consistency. Compare tone, vocabulary, visual direction, and calls to action against the supplied guidelines.

prompt_templates.title: Define Asset Governance
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an asset governance workflow for [team]. Include naming rules, folder structure, approval states, metadata, and validation checks.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Design Token Sync
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced implementation planning for design systems.
prompt_templates.prompt: Map approved brand colors and typography into design token updates. Identify source guideline sections, destination tokens, risks, and review steps.

output_examples.input: A founder needs a first brand guide for a new analytics product.
output_examples.output: A structured guide with voice traits, core messages, color roles, typography, logo rules, imagery direction, and approval checkpoints.

output_examples.input: A designer asks why a campaign banner feels off-brand.
output_examples.output: A review that flags color drift, inconsistent typography, weak voice alignment, and practical fixes before publication.

output_examples.input: A developer needs to update design tokens from approved brand colors.
output_examples.output: A sync plan that identifies guideline sources, token destinations, dry-run checks, and review steps for changed files.

best_practices: Keep docs/brand-guidelines.md current before running context or token scripts.
Review generated naming and asset suggestions before changing shared files.
Confirm color contrast and font licensing outside the skill before publishing.
anti_patterns: Do not treat placeholder template values as approved brand standards.
Do not run sync scripts in repositories without reviewing pending token changes.
Do not paste confidential brand strategy into prompts unless your tool policy allows it.

faq.question: Does this skill create a full brand system?
faq.answer: It provides structure, templates, and review workflows. Final strategic choices still need human approval.

faq.question: Can it run with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Does it modify files automatically?
faq.answer: The included token sync script can update token files when you run it. Review changes before committing them.

faq.question: Can it extract colors from images?
faq.answer: It prepares ImageMagick or multimodal analysis instructions. It does not perform full image extraction by itself.

faq.question: Is it suitable for trademark review?
faq.answer: No. Use qualified legal review for trademark clearance, licensing, and brand ownership questions.

faq.question: What files does it expect?
faq.answer: It expects brand guidelines, design token files, and optional asset manifest files in the working repository.
